import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from normalize import normalize_text

SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "normalize.py"


def run_tool(path):
    return subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, str(SCRIPT), str(path)],
        check=True, capture_output=True, text=True,
    )


SAMPLE_2SPACE = '''{
  "name": "demo-config",
  "status": "  ACTIVE  ",
  "retries": 3,
  "greeting": "caf\\u00e9",
  "endpoints": [
    "https://api.example.com",
    "https://backup.example.com"
  ],
  "limits": {
    "cpu": 2,
    "memory": "512Mi"
  },
  "empty_map": {},
  "empty_list": []
}
'''

SAMPLE_TABS = '{\n\t"status": "  Mixed Case ",\n\t"n": 1\n}\n'

SAMPLE_MINIFIED = '{"status":"  Active ","n":1}'

SAMPLE_LITERAL_UNICODE = '{\n  "status": " Active ",\n  "greeting": "caf\u00e9"\n}\n'


@pytest.fixture
def sample_file(tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path / "sample.json"
    path.write_text(SAMPLE_2SPACE, encoding="utf-8")
    return path


def test_normalize_text_applies_normalization():
    text, changed = normalize_text(SAMPLE_2SPACE)
    assert changed is True
    assert json.loads(text)["status"] == "active"


# --- Desired behavior after the patch: unchanged parts keep original formatting ---

def test_preserves_indentation(sample_file):
    run_tool(sample_file)
    result = sample_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert result == SAMPLE_2SPACE.replace("  ACTIVE  ", "active")


def test_preserves_trailing_newline(sample_file):
    run_tool(sample_file)
    assert sample_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8").endswith("\n")


def test_preserves_non_ascii_literal(sample_file):
    run_tool(sample_file)
    # The original file styles this as \u00e9; that styling is preserved verbatim.
    assert "caf\\u00e9" in sample_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")


def test_preserves_literal_unicode_char():
    path = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "_tmp_uni.json"
    path.write_text(SAMPLE_LITERAL_UNICODE, encoding="utf-8")
    try:
        run_tool(path)
        assert path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == SAMPLE_LITERAL_UNICODE.replace(
            '" Active "', '"active"'
        )
    finally:
        path.unlink(missing_ok=True)


def test_preserves_tab_indentation():
    path = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "_tmp_tabs.json"
    path.write_text(SAMPLE_TABS, encoding="utf-8")
    try:
        run_tool(path)
        assert path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == SAMPLE_TABS.replace("  Mixed Case ", "mixed case")
    finally:
        path.unlink(missing_ok=True)


def test_preserves_minified_style():
    path = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "_tmp_min.json"
    path.write_text(SAMPLE_MINIFIED, encoding="utf-8")
    try:
        run_tool(path)
        assert path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == '{"status":"active","n":1}'
    finally:
        path.unlink(missing_ok=True)


def test_no_rewrite_when_already_normalized(sample_file):
    run_tool(sample_file)
    first = sample_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    run_tool(sample_file)
    assert sample_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == first


# --- Tool contract stays intact ---

def test_cli_runs_and_changes_value(sample_file):
    run_tool(sample_file)
    assert json.loads(sample_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["status"] == "active"


def test_normalize_text_reports_changed_false_when_no_change():
    text, changed = normalize_text(SAMPLE_MINIFIED.replace('"  Active "', '"active"'))
    assert changed is False
